note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative. The decision carries ONLY editable placeholder text; the two labels are neutral labels supplied by the party, of equal weight; a relation means only that a label was attached to a section by the party (as supplied). No grounds catalogue, admissibility, time limit, standard of review, evaluation of any section, outcome or jurisdiction is drawn.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: One party: the two label cards and the numbered sections are pulled out of the room to a band above it and labelled on the plan; the party supplies each label and each label is attached to its located section (as supplied), A and B together; two tracers run the mirror routes at the same time; the sections are the focus.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: two participants (the magnifier held by the second), label B first on the board, three sections, other label texts, the relationships listed in another order; label B's card is the focus.

presets.name: long-labels-stress
presets.description: Near-maximum lengths and counts: three participants and six elements with long labels (in a crowded 1:1 frame the room and its calendar may be named in the panel), long label texts, four sections, two located per label (one shared, as supplied), long relation captions and a five-step traversal (its mirror traced at the same time).
